node.statement: By lem-routef-raw-factor-setting-formation, C_theta=12*(sqrt(2)-1) and C_A=20+(211/8)*C_theta are finite positive reals, eta_A and epsilon_E are positive, C_E is a finite real, and all remaining scalar quantities are defined by equations (1.1)-(1.8) of def-routef-raw-factor-setting. Those equations give bar-C_E=max{1,C_E}>=1, C_V=bar-C_E*C_A>0, C_T=C_theta+3*C_V>0, and recursively finite nonnegative C_Delta-prime,C_Delta,C_2,C_3,C_N,C_R,C_L and C_Upsilon'=1+C_theta+2*C_Delta+2*C_L>0.
